tables.name: burden_records
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE burden_records (
    id                    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    control_number        TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES icrs(control_number),
    ic_title              TEXT,                -- per-InformationCollection; NULL = ICR total
    respondents           INTEGER,
    total_responses       INTEGER,
    burden_hours          INTEGER,
    burden_cost           REAL,
    annual_federal_cost   REAL,
    hours_per_response    REAL,               -- derived: burden_hours / total_responses
    reporting_frequency   TEXT,               -- from XML BurdenHourPerResponse/ReportingFrequencies
    obligation_code       TEXT,
    affected_public_code  TEXT,
    xml_snapshot_date     TEXT NOT NULL        -- when the inventory XML was pulled
)

tables.name: claim_passports
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE claim_passports (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id          INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_runs(id),
    symbol          TEXT NOT NULL,             -- parameter/figure identifier
    value           TEXT,
    expected        TEXT,
    match           TEXT,                      -- 'yes' | 'no' | 'explained'
    source_location TEXT,
    raw_quote       TEXT,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN
                    ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'STALE', 'UNVERIFIED', 'EXPLAINED'))
)

tables.name: extracted_tables
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE extracted_tables (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    section_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ss_sections(id),
    table_index INTEGER NOT NULL,              -- 0-based within the section
    caption     TEXT,
    cells_json  TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- {headers: [...], rows: [[...]]}
    numeric_ok  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0     -- 1 = all numeric cells parsed cleanly
)

tables.name: icr_documents
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE icr_documents (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    control_number  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES icrs(control_number),
    object_id       TEXT,                      -- reginfo DownloadDocument objectID
    doc_type        TEXT,                      -- 'ss_part_a' | 'ss_part_b' | 'form' | 'notice' | 'other'
    orig_format     TEXT,                      -- 'docx' | 'doc' | 'pdf'
    filename        TEXT,
    converted_path  TEXT,                      -- relative path under corpus/md
    fidelity        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high'
                    CHECK (fidelity IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')),
    converted_ok    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
)

tables.name: icrs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE icrs (
    control_number  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,          -- '1652-0001'
    ref_nbr         TEXT,                      -- latest ICR reference 'YYYYMM-1652-NNN'
    title           TEXT,
    abstract        TEXT,
    agency_code     TEXT,                      -- '1652' for TSA; benchmarks differ
    cfr_cites       TEXT,
    affected_public TEXT,
    icr_type        TEXT,                      -- e.g. 'Extension without change...'
    icr_status      TEXT,                      -- 'Active' etc.
    expiration_date TEXT,
    is_benchmark    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, -- 1 = other-agency exemplar
    latest          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
)

tables.name: reference_series
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE reference_series (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    series_kind   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (series_kind IN
                  ('oews_wage', 'ecec_factor', 'enplanements', 'gsa_perdiem',
                   'irs_mileage', 'deflator', 'gs_wage', 'other')),
    key1          TEXT,                        -- e.g. SOC code / airport code / GS grade
    key2          TEXT,                        -- e.g. area / series qualifier
    year          INTEGER NOT NULL,            -- data year
    vintage       TEXT NOT NULL,               -- release identifier, e.g. 'OEWS May 2024'
    value         REAL NOT NULL,
    unit          TEXT,                        -- '$/hr' | 'ratio' | 'count' | '$/mi' | 'index'
    source_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    raw_quote     TEXT,                        -- verbatim published figure
    superseded_by INTEGER REFERENCES reference_series(id)  -- newer vintage row
)

tables.name: review_findings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE review_findings (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_runs(id),
    rule_id   TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- 'MATH-001'
    severity  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('critical', 'major', 'minor')),
    status    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN
              ('PASS', 'FAIL', 'STALE', 'UNVERIFIED', 'EXPLAINED')),
    location  TEXT,                            -- 'Q12 table 1 row 3' + line numbers
    message   TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected  TEXT,
    actual    TEXT
)

tables.name: review_runs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE review_runs (
    id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    doc_ref   TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- file path or control number reviewed
    run_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    score     REAL,
    verdict   TEXT,                            -- 'pass' | 'fail' | band label
    override_reason TEXT                       -- non-null when a gate was overridden
)

tables.name: source_edits
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_edits (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    edited_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    table_name  TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'sources' | 'reference_series'
    row_id      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    field       TEXT,
    old_value   TEXT,
    new_value   TEXT,
    reason      TEXT NOT NULL
)

tables.name: source_locators
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_locators (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    source_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    locator     TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 'Table 3, row 12' / 'p. 47' / cell ref
    raw_quote   TEXT                           -- verbatim text or figure as published
)

tables.name: sources
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE sources (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name            TEXT NOT NULL,
    -- Controlled vocabulary (sibling-project convention):
    -- 'Government primary' | 'Government memo' | 'Government AAR' | 'Peer-reviewed'
    -- | 'Institutional research' | 'Working paper' | 'Industry standard'
    -- | 'News (sourced to government)'
    type            TEXT NOT NULL,
    methodology     TEXT,                      -- how the source derives its data
    data_extracted  TEXT,                      -- what we take from it
    strengths       TEXT,
    limitations     TEXT,                      -- limitations / biases
    feeds           TEXT,                      -- back-pointers: e.g. 'Q12,Q14' or model section anchors
    tier            INTEGER CHECK (tier IN (1, 2, 3)),
    url             TEXT,
    accessed_date   TEXT,                      -- ISO 8601
    data_year       INTEGER,                   -- vintage of the data itself
    publisher       TEXT,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED'
                    CHECK (status IN ('VERIFIED', 'UNVERIFIED', 'STALE')),
    notes           TEXT
)

tables.name: ss_sections
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE ss_sections (
    id                    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    document_id           INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES icr_documents(id),
    question_no           INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (question_no BETWEEN 0 AND 18), -- 0 = preamble
    heading               TEXT,
    md_text               TEXT,
    start_line            INTEGER,
    end_line              INTEGER,
    extraction_confidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high'
                          CHECK (extraction_confidence IN ('high', 'medium', 'low'))
)

| Reporting | 100 | $30.00[^1][^1] | $3,000.00 | $500.00[^1] | $3,500.00 |
